name: worktree-task
description: Run each Claude Code task in its own git worktree and branch, reviewed and merged after your OK.

plugins.name: worktree-task
plugins.description: One task per worktree folder and branch: tests first when they help, a fresh-context Claude review, an optional Codex review through codex-review-loop, then one commit and a fast-forward merge into the base branch after your OK, with a report in your terminal.
